findings.reference_range: >90 normal; 60–89 mild; 30–59 moderate; 15‑29 severe; <15 kidney failure
findings.clinical_note: Stage 4 chronic kidney disease with markedly reduced filtration; high risk for cardiovascular events and progression to end-stage renal disease; nephrology referral and preparation for renal replacement therapy are indicated.
Consistent with reduced GFR; supports the eGFR finding of severe renal impairment.
Proteinuria in the nephrotic range suggests glomerular damage and predicts faster CKD progression.
Dilute urine may reflect over‑hydration post‑dialysis or impaired concentrating ability of damaged kidneys.
Ketonuria may indicate recent fasting, low carbohydrate intake, or inadequate glucose utilization; correlate with clinical context.
